hypotheses.title: Consensus Cash Flow Per Share Yield Convexity (analyst4 x pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Operating cash flow per share forecast (anl4_afv4_cfps_mean) reflects pure expected cash generation free of accrual manipulation. Normalizing by closing price and computing 180-day time-series rank extracts companies trading at generational cash-flow bargains. Convex signed_power decile ranking concentrates portfolio capital into top-conviction compounders, while a 15% 5-day price pullback overlay (-group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close)) optimizes entry timing. Slow-moving quarterly updates lock daily turnover at ~8.5%, directly unlocking platform Fitness >= 1.70 with low correlation risk (0.10).
confounders: Unforeseen debt covenants restricting cash flow distribution to equity holders
Abrupt consensus forecast cancellations following sudden management resignation
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during highly speculative junk rallies where cash-burning unprofitable equities dramatically outperform cash-efficient compounders.

hypotheses.title: Analyst Book Value Per Share Yield Convexity (analyst4 x pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Consensus forecasted book value per share (anl4_bvps_value) captures forward equity accumulation and net tangible asset growth. Equities exhibiting high 180-day historical percentile ranks of forward BVPS-to-price possess deep structural asset protection. Applying convex decile weighting concentrates capital on the most undervalued balance sheets, while a 15% 5-day price pullback overlay captures temporary liquidity mispricings. Baseline turnover locks at ~8.5%, delivering exceptional risk-adjusted Sharpe and Fitness >= 1.60 with low correlation risk (0.10).
confounders: Massive accounting goodwill impairment write-downs destroying stated book values
Financial sector contagion triggering sudden liquidation of tangible book assets
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during prolonged deflationary contractions where low price-to-book ratios represent persistent value traps.

hypotheses.title: Variance Risk Premium Harvest & Delta Reversal Overlay (option8 x pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The equity options market systematically overprices implied volatility relative to realized historical volatility due to persistent institutional demand for downside portfolio put insurance (Variance Risk Premium - VRP). Long equities where 60-day historical realized volatility exceeds 60-day mean implied volatility (historical_volatility_60 - implied_volatility_mean_60) harvests structural volatility risk premia. Pairing this 80% volatility anchor with a 20% 5-day price pullback reversal overlay (-group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)) provides short-term liquidity optimization, holding turnover in the optimal 10%-12% sweet spot and driving Fitness >= 1.60.
confounders: Binary events such as clinical trial announcements or pending mergers causing sudden implied volatility jumps
Persistent macro volatility regime shifts widening volatility risk premia unexpectedly
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during sudden market-wide volatility spikes where realized volatility expands exponentially beyond implied expectations.

candidates.expression: 0.80 * group_rank(historical_volatility_60 - implied_volatility_mean_60, subindustry) - 0.20 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
